column1:
• 生效范围：自述文件（README）、Issue / PR 主帖、发布说明等**正文页**（评论区为 Compose 原生渲染，暂不在范围内）。
• **开启入口只有本页的「自动翻译正文」**：开着时正文页会出现可移动悬浮球（可拖动），单击展开「翻译工具菜单」——显示进度（已译 / 候选段数、字符数）、常用开关与「翻译全文 / 清空本页译文」等操作，点面板外任意位置或右上角「×」收起为悬浮球。面板里的「本页翻译」开关一关，悬浮球立刻收起（不翻译时页面不留控件）；要再打开，回到本页开总开关。菜单里的开关与本页读写同一份设置，改哪边都是新的（Key / 模型 / 接入地址只能在**本页**改）。
• 整页候选文本少于 5000 字符时一次翻完，更长时按视口滚动逐段翻译（省额度）。
• 翻译服务：MyMemory 免费匿名（额度约 5000 词/天）；DeepSeek 需要你自己的 API Key，按 token 计费。服务不可用时（额度用尽 / Key 无效 / 连续失败）会自动暂停，并在悬浮球与工具菜单上给出提示。
• 隐私：只把**正文段落文本**发往你选择的服务；DeepSeek 的 Key 存于应用私有目录、不注入网页、不写日志。正文里出现的 URL / @提及 / #编号 / 提交 SHA 会先占位保护、译后还原。
column2:
• Scope: article pages such as README files, issue / PR bodies and release notes (comments are rendered natively by Compose and are not covered yet).
• The only entry point is “Auto-translate article text” on this page: while it is on, article pages show a draggable floating button. Tap it to open the translation tools — progress (translated / candidate segments, character count), the common switches, and actions such as “Translate all” and “Clear this page”. Tap anywhere outside the panel or the × in its top-right corner to collapse it back into the button. Turning off “Translate this page” in the panel hides the button immediately, so no control is left on the page when nothing is being translated; to bring it back, turn the master switch on again here. The switches in the panel and on this page read and write the same settings, so either side is always current (the key, model and endpoint can only be changed on this page).
• Pages with fewer than 5000 candidate characters are translated in one go; longer pages are translated segment by segment as you scroll (to save quota).
• Services: MyMemory is free and anonymous (about 5000 words per day); DeepSeek requires your own API key and is billed per token. When a service is unavailable (quota exhausted, invalid key, repeated failures) translation pauses automatically and a hint appears on the floating button and in the tools panel.
• Privacy: only the text of article paragraphs is sent to the service you choose. The DeepSeek key is stored in the app's private directory, is not injected into web pages and is not written to logs. URLs, @mentions, #numbers and commit SHAs in the text are placeholder-protected first and restored after translation.
